decisions.reason: The organic platter sits close to the core range and supports the firm's announced organic expansion, but it only gets a low-key mention on the website, so little visible commitment protects it.
The firm promoted the premium sharing snack prominently and widened it with a poultry variant, so it has publicly committed to the line and would find it hard to justify withdrawing it soon.
The organic Fleischwurst launched recently with its own page and a public 'new in the organic team' announcement, so weak early results would still be put down to the start-up phase.
Launched in 2024 in two flavors with dedicated presentation, the organic chicken slices are central to the announced organic expansion, and dropping them now would expose the investment as a mistake.
The organic herb salami is a fresh launch with its own page, close to core salami capabilities, and too new for disappointing results to be anything but temporary.
